name: cavemio-pricing-toggle
title: Pricing toggle
description: Monthly or yearly: the thumb slides with a little give, and every price on the page rolls to its new amount.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The toggle is a real radio group: arrow keys move between periods, and only the chosen one is in the tab order.
- Prices are real text for screen readers; the rolling digits are decoration on top.
- Installs Number roll alongside it.
- Price hydrates cleanly when server-rendered: without locales it formats in en-US until hydration, then in the visitor’s locale, swapped in place. The note is your own text, so if you write amounts in it, pass the same locales to Price to keep them alike.
- With reduced motion, the thumb jumps and prices change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: options
props.description: Monthly, Yearly “Save 20%” · Any number of periods, e.g. add Lifetime.

props.name: Price: amount / currency / period
props.description: — / "USD" / "/mo" · The figure that rolls, its currency, and the period after it (hidden at 0).

props.name: Price: locales
props.description: – · Format the price in this locale on the server and in the browser. Without it, a server render shows en-US and switches to the visitor’s locale after hydration ("$29" can become "US$29" in en-GB).

props.name: Price: note / direction
props.description: – · The line under the price, sliding in from the way the toggle moved.

props.name: Price: numberClassName
props.description: – · Size and weight of the figure.
